mechanism: Both drugs possess anticholinergic properties that are additive, and amantadine is metabolized by CYP2D6 which tolterodine inhibits, potentially increasing amantadine levels.
action: Monitor for anticholinergic adverse effects (urinary retention, constipation, cognitive changes); consider dose adjustment of amantadine if tolterodine is added; assess renal function as both drugs are renally cleared.
